name: Murindi Trend Portfolio v1
description: Vol-targeted multi-sleeve trend-following. The only research edge that survived independent multi-year, cost-aware, out-of-sample, permutation-tested re-validation.

sleeves.note: 4th sleeve: confirmed trend edge (beats permutation). ~0.84 asset-correlated to BTC, so size BTC+ETH together as one ~50% crypto allocation. Tested daily; if H4 ETH data is available, prefer 4h with bars_per_year 2190.

factor_allocation_note: Two uncorrelated factors: METALS (XAU+XAG, ~0.77 internal) and CRYPTO (BTC+ETH, ~0.84 internal); metals<->crypto ~0.07. Keep ~50/50 metals/crypto; do not let crypto dominate.

news_guard._note: LLM-free entry guard. Add this to each sleeve's trading_config. Blocks NEW ENTRIES (never exits) during high-impact event windows (NFP/CPI/FOMC/ECB/...) and keyword-detected market shocks. Pure downside protection; recommended ON. Fail-open (never blocks if offline).

regime_filter_note: OPTIONAL strategy param (regime_filter=true). A/B on gold: PF 1.49->1.78 and max DD 18.3%->8.2%, BUT trades drop 313->100 and it no longer beats the permutation test (sample too small + the Hurst threshold is fittable). Keep OFF for the significance-validated config; enable only if you prefer fewer, higher-conviction trades and lower drawdown.
